name: desktop-apps-macos-linux
description: Desktop Apps (macOS & Linux): platform architecture (Darwin/launchd/bundles vs kernel/compositor/D-Bus/systemd), SwiftUI/AppKit and GTK4/libadwaita/Qt6, cross-platform frameworks (Electron, Tauri, Flutter, Avalonia, Compose Multiplatform, Rust GUIs), Wayland vs X11, native desktop idioms, packaging and distribution (notarization, Mac App Store, Flatpak, Snap, AppImage, distro packages), auto-update, sandboxing and privacy (TCC, entitlements, XDG portals), and testing/CI.
